## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant public issue.

## Verification

Describe each acceptance case's setup, action, expected result and actual result.
List commands run and any checks not run. Attach only synthetic or redacted evidence.

For behavior changes, link the relevant public acceptance contract and describe
fixtures/regressions added. For UI changes, include both-theme evidence.
Keep the PR focused; explain changes larger than the contribution size guide.
Each commit needs your DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`); see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
